description: Check a token on BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base or Arc for traps before buying it. ChainK9 forks the chain and really buys and sells the token in a sandbox (its V2 or V3 pool: PancakeSwap on BSC, where a V2 pair against USDT or USDC is traded through BNB, Uniswap on Ethereum and Base; or its Uniswap V4 pool, hook included, against the native coin or, traded through it, USDT or USDC; on Arc, its V4 pool against USDC), then runs 60+ checks: honeypot, hidden and changing buy and sell taxes, owner pause, blacklist, mint and confiscation powers, transfer and sell limits, cooldowns, liquidity, upgrade authority. Returns a verdict (danger, caution, ok) and every check's result. Results are reused for 10 minutes. Not charged when the address isn't a token or has no liquidity yet (422). Costs $0.02 per successful call in USDC on Base, paid with x402 in the call's _meta; failed calls are free.
